name: Rivet
description: Runs stateful AI agents, workflows, and sandboxed code as Rivet Actors with SQLite storage on S3, for developers building durable agent backends at scale.

skills.name: Durable Actors
skills.description: Creates long-lived actors with in-memory state, a per-actor SQLite database, WebSockets, and scheduling, one per agent, user, or session.

skills.name: Workflows
skills.description: Runs multi-step operations on actors that replay from where they stopped instead of starting over after a restart.

skills.name: agentOS Sandbox
skills.description: Runs the code an agent writes in a Linux-compatible JS and Python sandbox with control over network, filesystem, and resource limits.

skills.name: Manage Actors over MCP
skills.description: Lists running actors, calls actor actions, and opens the Actor Inspector from an MCP client through Rivet's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Realtime Broadcasts
skills.description: Broadcasts events to every connected client over WebSockets, such as streaming model tokens to all users of one agent.
